::: {.hero}
[Life cycle assessment of technologies that do not exist at scale yet is hard: the data is thin, the designs are still changing, and AI tools are arriving faster than guidance on how to use them. We are a volunteer community of LCA researchers and practitioners working on these problems in the open, publishing early and updating often.]{.lead}
:::

## What we are working on

::: {.project-cards}
::: {.card-p}
### [Tiers of LCA](projects/tiers.qmd)
A framework for grading how robust an LCA of an emerging technology can be, indicator by indicator. Paper in final drafting.
:::
::: {.card-p}
### [AI for LCA of emerging technologies](projects/ai-for-lca.qmd)
When AI assistance is reliable, when it needs close checking, and when it should not be used, mapped to technology readiness. Literature review and journal club underway.
:::
::: {.card-p}
### [Design flexibility across TRL](projects/design-flexibility.qmd)
Where in scale-up design choices are still open and where they lock in, so LCA can inform decisions instead of reporting after them. Subgroup forming now.
:::
:::
